name: Fey Wanderer

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A ranger touched by the Feywild who strikes with psychic power and charms with otherworldly glamour.

feature.name: Dreadful Strikes
feature.summary: Once per turn per creature, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d4 Psychic damage (1d6 at level 11).
feature.text: You can augment your weapon strikes with mind-scarring magic from the Feywild. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage to it; a creature can take this extra damage only once per turn. The die becomes a d6 at Ranger level 11.

feature.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
feature.summary: Charm Person always prepared; more at levels 5, 9, 13 and 17.
feature.text: When you reach a Ranger level shown, you always have these spells prepared; they don't count against your Prepared Spells: Charm Person (3); Misty Step (5); Summon Fey (9); Dimension Door (13); Mislead (17).

feature.name: Otherworldly Glamour
feature.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to Charisma checks, and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.
feature.text: Whenever you make a Charisma check, you gain a bonus equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). You also gain proficiency in one of these skills of your choice: Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

feature.name: Beguiling Twist
feature.summary: Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened; when a creature near you succeeds on such a save, a Reaction can Charm or Frighten another.
feature.text: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition. In addition, whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to force a different creature you can see within 120 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure it is Charmed or Frightened (your choice) for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. The Advantage is applied; the Reaction waits for the combat engine.

feature.name: Fey Reinforcements
feature.summary: Summon Fey is always ready: cast it once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components, and you can choose a version without Concentration.

feature.name: Misty Wanderer
feature.summary: Cast Misty Step without a slot Wisdom-modifier times per Long Rest, bringing a willing creature along.
